# Alexandr Chumak

> EU citizen, no sponsorship required. Senior Frontend Engineer with 6+ years building for production in React, TypeScript and Next.js. Currently Lead Frontend Developer at Multisoft (Romania, remote). Open to senior frontend and AI product roles across the EU.

Builds the client app for the Multisoft restaurant CRM: order and menu modules, reporting tables, filtering, long forms. Also built Rivella single-handedly, an AI sales-assistant SaaS on Next.js: the LLM layer with prompts, dialogue flows and a per-tenant knowledge base, the backend and data schema, multi-tenancy and auth, YClients and Telegram integrations, and an admin panel with analytics and billing tiers — built end to end, not launched to production yet. Five years before that at EVCARGO on an e-mobility logistics platform, owning the design system, component library and client-side architecture, and running frontend code review. Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, React Native / Expo, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Zod. Based in Chișinău, UTC+2.
